caption: The drawing features a landscape dominated by multiple tall trees with light blue and white trunks and dark green, olive, and brown leaves, set against a blue sky. In the middle ground, there is a light-colored arched bridge extending from one side of the image to the other. On the bridge, there are two human figures, one standing and the other mounted on a horse. In the foreground, there are four white or pale-colored animals resembling sheep or goats dispersed across an area of dark green foliage. A bird in white is shown flying in the upper right quadrant, and there are various green and brown patches representing additional foliage or plants throughout the scene. The overall color palette consists mostly of shades of blue, green, white, and brown. Below the image, on the cream-colored background, there is a scale indicating measurements in inches, a lightly sketched rectangular outline to the right, and a handwritten signature at the bottom right.
